info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Trade Banking By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve detailed information about specific trade banking credit facilities using a designated parameter. It is designed for financial institutions and businesses that require access to credit facility details for various trade banking purposes. By providing the parameter, users can obtain tailored data that supports decision-making and financial analysis. Typical consumers include banking professionals, financial analysts, and compliance officers who need to review credit options and evaluate funding capabilities.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific credit facility by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a credit facility using its unique identifier. It provides essential information regarding the facility's terms, amounts, and status, which can help in making informed financial decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding the credit facility with the identifier RES-100045 in the trade banking system. It must be structured according to the required JSON schema, ensuring that the necessary parameters and values are provided for successful processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully; returns the credit facility details.
